title: Found unused file: config_legacy.py
body:
Hey team,

While looking through the codebase I noticed there's an old config file sitting around:

`src/config_legacy.py`

It looks like it has hardcoded settings that aren't being used anymore - the main config.py handles everything now. I couldn't find any imports for it.

Might want to clean this up when you get a chance.

Cheers,
Carlos

comments.body: Thanks for flagging this Carlos! Yes, `src/config_legacy.py` is safe to delete - it's leftover from the v1.x to v2.0 migration and nothing references it anymore.
